mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the past month compresses discount rates for equity valuation, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. This mechanism is active whenever FEDFUNDS shows a negative 1-month change.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.1% over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5.5% within the past month indicates deteriorating labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE rises above 5.5% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and rise in retail sales (RSAFS) signals a supply-constrained demand environment that typically generates positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO declines by at least 0.5% and RSAFS rises by at least 0.5% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%) combined with high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 60 days due to reduced real cash flows and higher discount rates.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and CPIAUCSL > 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1700 thousand units indicates weakening consumer demand, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where HOUST falls below 1700.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 117.0 (index value) indicates a contraction in manufacturing output, which typically results in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO falls below 117.0.

mechanism_narrative: In a labor market recovery phase (UNRATE < 5.0% and PAYEMS > 132000 thousand), strong employment growth signals robust economic expansion, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE < 5.0 and PAYEMS > 132000.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) above 3.0% annually compresses real equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL rises above 3.0% annually.
